name: Clothing
overview: Scripture reveals that clothing is both a practical provision from God and a symbol of His care, as seen when He clothed Adam and Eve with coats of skins after their awareness of nakedness (Genesis 3:7, 21). The Israelites experienced God's sustaining power, with their garments and shoes not wearing out during forty years in the wilderness, demonstrating His faithful provision (Deuteronomy 8:4; 29:5). Additionally, God’s instructions on clothing emphasize distinctions in gender and purity, forbidding cross-dressing and mixing fabrics, highlighting obedience to His holiness (Deuteronomy 22:5, 11).
